regime_detail: D for observational methods; D+I for GIES with targets
orientation_rule: none: undecided reachability is an abstention

metric_defs.coverage: share of (target, variable) pairs given a committed claim
metric_defs.precision_committed: share of committed claims that match the true graph
metric_defs.lift_over_empty_graph: precision minus the empty graph's precision on the same files
metric_defs.risk_coverage_replicate_agreement: precision of the claims with the highest replicate agreement, by coverage
metric_defs.dv2: target choice for a named outcome: answer rate, success when answering, random baseline
metric_defs.threshold: stylised act/do-nothing comparison at cost ratio c/g
